item.title: Government Appoints Soprano Sumi Jo as Ambassador for Cultural Cooperation (정부, 소프라노 조수미 ‘문화협력대사’ 임명)
item.description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 8th that the government has appointed soprano Sumi Jo as Ambassador for Cultural Cooperation, a special diplomatic title, and Seong-hoon Lee, an adjunct professor at Sungkonghoe University's Graduate School of Citizen Peace, as Ambassador for Human Rights, Peace, and Democracy. (정부가 소프라노 조수미를 대외직명대사인 문화협력대사로, 이성훈 성공회대 시민평화대학원 겸임교수를 인권평화민주주의대사로 각각 임명했다고 외교부가 8일 밝혔다.)

The special diplomatic title system grants the rank of ambassador to private individuals with expertise and recognition in various fields, enabling them to engage in diplomatic activities, with a term of one year. (대외직명대사는 각 분야에서 전문성과 인지도를 겸비한 민간 인사에게 대사 직명을 부여해 외교 활동을 할 수 있도록 하는 제도로 임기는 1년이다.)

Ambassador Jo has previously served as a promotional ambassador for the Korea-Japan World Cup, a cultural and public diplomacy envoy for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, and a promotional ambassador for the PyeongChang Winter Olympics. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that Ambassador Jo, leveraging her international recognition, is expected to enhance understanding of public and cultural diplomacy policies through participation in major domestic and international cultural events and outreach activities. (조수미 대사는 한·일 월드컵 홍보대사와 외교통상부 문화홍보외교사절, 평창동계올림픽 홍보대사 등을 역임했다. 외교부는 조 대사가 국제적 인지도를 바탕으로 주요 국내외 문화행사 참석, 아웃리치 활동 등을 통해 공공·문화외교 정책에 대한 이해를 높일 것으로 기대된다고 밝혔다.)

Ambassador Lee has served as the executive director of the Korea Human Rights Foundation, head of the Policy Bureau of the National Human Rights Commission, and secretary-general of the Asian Human Rights Coalition. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs explained that Ambassador Lee will attend international conferences, such as those of the UN Human Rights Council, and strengthen cooperation networks with international civil society to expand the government's participation in global discussions on human rights, peace, and democracy. (이성훈 대사는 한국인권재단 상임이사와 국가인권위원회 정책본부장, 아시아인권단체연합 사무총장 등을 지냈다. 외교부는 이 대사가 유엔 인권이사회 등 국제회의에 참석하고 국제 시민사회와 협력 네트워크를 강화해 국제 인권·평화·민주주의 논의에 대한 정부의 참여를 확대해 나갈 것이라고 설명했다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh “Request Party to Form a Special Committee for Gangnam 4 Districts” Jeong Cheong-rae “Immediately” (정원오 “당에 강남 4구 특별위원회 구성해달라” 정청래 “즉각”)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, visited Songpa District with Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh on the 8th to hold an on-site supreme council meeting. Candidate Jung requested the formation of a special committee (tentatively named) for the four Gangnam districts, and Leader Jeong replied, “I will do it immediately.” This is seen as a courtship move toward the party’s weak regions. The term “Gangnam 4 Districts” collectively refers to Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa, and Gangdong districts. (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 8일 정원오 서울시장 후보와 함께 송파구를 찾아 현장 최고위원회를 열었다. 정 후보 ‘강남 4구 특별위원회(가칭) 구성’을 요청했고, 정 대표는 “즉각 하겠다”고 답했다. 민주당 열세 지역에 대한 구애 행보인 셈이다. ‘강남 4구’는 강남·서초·송파·강동구를 아울러 부르는 말이다.)

At the supreme council meeting held that day at the campaign office of Democratic Party Songpa district chief candidate Jo Jae-hee, Candidate Jung stated, “The People Power Party’s candidate Oh Se-hoon only blames the (Lee Jae-myung) government for real estate issues, but I will use Jung Won-oh’s hands-on administration, which transformed Seongsu-dong, to resolve the neglected inconveniences of citizens in the four Gangnam districts.” He mentioned issues such as the contract problems in the express bus terminal underground shopping mall, anxiety over underground safety after sinkholes, and concerns about the commercial void following the demolition of Jamsil Baseball Stadium, adding, “I will ensure that the citizens of the four Gangnam districts can feel the capabilities of President Lee Jae-myung and Jung Won-oh.” He then said, “I request the party to form a special committee for the four Gangnam districts to systematically resolve citizen inconveniences one by one.” Leader Jeong responded, “If you ask for a development special committee, I will make it happen immediately.” ( 이날 민주당 조재희 송파구청장 후보 선거사무소에서 열린 최고위원회에서 정 후보는 “오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 부동산 문제에 (이재명) 정부 탓만 하고 있는데, 성수동을 변화시킨 정원오의 현장 행정으로 강남 4구에 그간 외면된 시민 불편을 풀어가겠다”고 말했다. 그는 고속버스터미널 지하상가 계약 문제와 싱크홀 이후 지하안전 불안감, 잠실야구장 철거 이후 상권 공백 우려 등을 언급하며 “이재명 대통령과 정원오의 실력을 강남 4구 시민이 체감할 수 있도록 하겠다”고 했다. 그러면서 “시민 불편을 하나씩 착착 해결하기 위해 당에 강남 4구 특별위원회 구성을 요구한다”고 말했다. 정 대표는 “발전특위 만들어달라, 즉각 하도록 하겠다”라고 답했다. )

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr ( 이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Woo Won-shik expresses 'deep regret' over PPP's filibuster notice on 'people's livelihood bills' (우원식, 국힘 ‘민생 법안' 필리버스터 예고에 “매우 유감”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik expressed "deep regret" on the 8th after the People Power Party (PPP) announced it would request a filibuster (unlimited debate) on the constitutional amendment and people's livelihood bills scheduled to be presented at the plenary session that afternoon. (우원식 국회의장은 8일 국민의힘이 이날 오후 본회의에 상정될 예정인 헌법개정안과 민생법안에 필리버스터(무제한 토론)를 신청하겠다고 하자 “매우 유감”이란 입장을 내놨다.)

Speaker Woo wrote on his Facebook page that day, "The National Assembly must not become a place that blocks even agreed-upon people's livelihood bills," and urged, "Do not make them a target of political strife; please cooperate in their processing." Speaker Woo stated, "Since the agreed-upon people's livelihood bills are promises to the people, their processing should not be delayed or blocked without a special reason. Therefore, at today's plenary session, along with the constitutional amendment that failed to pass yesterday due to a lack of votes, we plan to present and process about 50 people's livelihood bills already agreed upon by both ruling and opposition parties through standing committees and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee." (우 의장은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “합의한 민생법안까지 가로막는 국회가 되어서는 안 된다”며 “정쟁의 대상으로 삼지 말고 처리에 협조해달라”고 썼다. 우 의장은 “(여야가) 합의한 민생법안은 국민 앞의 약속인 만큼 특별한 이유 없이 처리를 미루거나 가로막아서는 안 된다”며 “그래서 오늘 본회의에는 어제 투표 불성립된 헌법개정안과 함께 여야가 상임위원회와 법제사법위원회를 거쳐 이미 합의한 민생법안 약 50건을 상정해 처리할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Speaker Woo added, "I recently received a message from a working mother. She said it was extremely urgent that the 'bill to expand the age of children eligible for parental leave,' which was agreed upon by both parties, had not been presented. Like this, each bill contains the lives and hopes of the people." (우 의장은 “지난번 한 워킹맘으로부터 메시지를 받았다. 여야가 합의 처리한 ‘육아휴직 대상 자녀 연령 확대 법안’이 상정되지 못해 너무나 절박하다는 내용이었다”며 “이처럼 법안 하나하나에는 국민의 삶과 희망이 담겨 있다”고도 했다.)

Speaker Woo also wrote, "It is even harder to understand that they would even filibuster the constitutional amendment," and noted, "If the PPP does not participate in the vote, it cannot pass anyway." Repeating his criticism, Woo said, "Filibustering the people's livelihood bills and the constitutional amendment that were agreed upon by both parties themselves goes against the purpose of the system." He added, "I ask PPP lawmakers: Please do not make even the people's livelihood bills already agreed upon by both parties a target of political strife, and cooperate in processing them at the plenary session with a responsible attitude that keeps promises to the people." (우 의장은 “특히 헌법개정안에까지 필리버스터를 하겠다는 것은 더욱 납득하기 어렵다”며 “국민의힘이 표결에 참여하지 않으면 어차피 통과될 수 없다”라고도 썼다. 우 의장은 “스스로 합의 처리한 민생법안과 헌법개정안에 대해 필리버스터를 하겠다는 것은 제도의 취지를 벗어난 일”이라고 거듭 비판하며 “국민의힘 의원들께 요청한다. 이미 여야가 합의한 민생법안만큼은 정쟁의 대상으로 삼지 말고 국민 앞의 약속을 지키는 책임 있는 자세로 본회의 처리에 협조해 주시길 바란다”고 했다．)

Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Observes Evaluation Test of Latest Destroyer 'Choe Hyon-ho' ... "Handover to Navy Next Month" (김정은, 최신 구축함 ‘최현호’ 평가시험 참관…“다음달 해군 인도”)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un observed the 'comprehensive maneuverability evaluation test' of North Korea's first 5,000-ton-class destroyer, the Choe Hyon-ho, and ordered its handover to the navy by mid-next month. Experts pointed out that if the Choe Hyon-ho is commissioned next month, tensions in the West Sea could escalate. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 북한의 첫 5000t급 구축함 최현호의 ‘기동능력 종합평가시험'을 참관하고 내달 중순 해군 인도를 지시했다. 전문가들은 최현호가 다음달 취역하게 되면 서해에서 긴장이 고조될 우려가 있다고 지적했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun reported on the 8th that Chairman Kim visited the destroyer Choe Hyon-ho on the 7th and observed the comprehensive maneuverability evaluation test conducted ahead of its commissioning. Although the Rodong Sinmun did not mention it separately, photos released showed Chairman Kim's daughter, Kim Ju-ae, accompanying him. The Choe Hyon-ho is a 5,000-ton-class multi-purpose attack destroyer, which held its launch ceremony at the Nampo Shipyard in April last year. (김 위원장은 지난 7일 구축함 최현호를 방문해 취역을 앞두고 진행하는 기동능력 종합평가시험을 참관했다고 노동신문이 8일 보도했다. 노동신문이 별도로 언급하지 않았지만 보도된 사진을 보면, 김 위원장의 딸 김주애가 동행했다. 최현호는 5000t급 다목적 공격형 구축함으로, 지난해 4월 남포조선소에서 진수식을 진행했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun stated that Chairman Kim "inspected various combat service spaces and elements, including the destroyer's integrated command post and weapons system control room, to understand the vessel's operational readiness." The location for the evaluation test was "a 120-nautical-mile (222 km) section of the West Sea of Korea (North Korea)." (김 위원장은 “구축함의 종합지휘소와 무기체계조종실을 비롯한 여러 전투근무 공간과 요소들을 돌아보시면서 함의 작전준비 실태를 료해(파악)”했다고 노동신문은 전했다. 평가시험이 진행된 장소는 “조선(북한) 서해상 120해리(222㎞) 구간”이다.)

Chairman Kim "assessed that all tests for the destroyer's operational commissioning are progressing smoothly" and "ordered that it be handed over to the navy as planned by mid-June." He also emphasized key tasks related to the establishment of a new naval base. (김 위원장은 “구축함의 작전취역을 위한 모든 시험들이 순조롭게 진척되고 있는 데 대하여 평가”하고, 계획대로 오는 6월 중순 해군에 인도할 데 대하여 명령”했다. 아울러 해군기지 신설과 관련한 중요 과업에 대해서도 강조했다.)

Chairman Kim received reports on issues concerning design changes for newly constructed third and fourth destroyers and the configuration of onboard weapons systems, and reached "important conclusions." Chairman Kim said, "Our new decision on the changed shipbuilding plan carries significant strategic character," adding, "This decision will fundamentally renew the readiness level of our military's strategic actions and bring about major changes in building war deterrence." (김 위원장은 새로 건조하는 3호·4호 구축함의 설계 변경 문제와 함상 무장체계 구성문제 관련 보고를 받고 ‘중요 결론'을 내렸다. 김 위원장은 변경된 함선 건조 계획에 대한 우리의 새로운 결정은 중대한 전략적 성격을 띤다”며 “이러한 결정은 우리 군대의 전략적 행동의 준비태세를 근본적으로 갱신하게 되며 전쟁억제력 구축에서 커다란 변화를 가져오게 된다”고 했다.)

Professor Lim Eul-chul of Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies interpreted this as "a sign that the 'navy strengthening line' to modernize the relatively underdeveloped naval forces since Kim Jong-un took power is producing concrete results." He added that "by specifying a deadline for 'commissioning in June,' it signals the possibility of additional shows of force, such as actual missile launches from the deployed destroyer, in the near future." Professor Lim analyzed that the deployment of the Choe Hyon-ho to the West Sea is "a direct check on South Korean naval forces and shows a willingness to engage in a head-to-head confrontation at sea, just as on land," and that revealing the specific maneuver zone of "120 nautical miles (about 222 km) in the West Sea" was a display of operational capability in the maritime border area, including near the Northern Limit Line (NLL). (임을출 경남대 극동문제연구소 교수는 “김정은 집권 이후 상대적으로 낙후되었던 해군력을 현대화하려는 ‘해군 강화 노선'이 실질적인 결과물로 나타나고 있다는 의미”라면서 “‘6월 취역'이라는 시한을 명시함으로써, 조만간 실전 배치된 구축함에서 실제 미사일 발사 등 추가적인 무력 시위가 이어질 가능성을 예고한다”고 해석했다. 임 교수는 최현호의 서해 배치는 “남측 해군 전력에 대한 직접적인 견제이며, 향후 해상에서도 지상과 마찬가지로 강 대 강 정면 승부에 나서겠다는 의지”라면서, ‘서해상 120해리(약 222km)’라는 구체적인 기동 구간을 공개한 것은 서해 북방한계선(NLL) 인근을 포함한 해상 접경 지역에서의 작전 능력을 과시한 것으로 분석했다.)

Professor Yang Moo-jin of the University of North Korean Studies said, "With the handover to the navy in mid-June, a large-scale 'fireworks ceremony to commission the Choe Hyon-ho' could serve as a pretext for missile test launches, raising tensions in the West Sea," adding that if a new naval base in the West Sea is established as Chairman Kim ordered, there are concerns about the routinization of conflicts in the West Sea. (양무진 북한 대학원대학교 석좌교수는 “6월 중순 해군 인도를 계기로 ‘최현호 취역 대규모 축포식’을 명분으로 한 미사일 시험발사로 서해 긴장 고조가 예상된다”면서, 김 위원장이 지시한 대로 서해 해군기지가 신설되면 서해상에서의 분쟁 일상화가 우려된다고 말했다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Hoarding is the Path to Ruin... Those Who Seek Unfair Profits Will Get Hurt Badly" (이 대통령 “매점매석 망하는 길…부당이익 취하다간 큰 코 다쳐”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 8th, "Hoarding is the path to ruin," adding, "There are still those who don't realize the world has changed and are heading toward destruction with outdated thinking, so I'm giving them an advance warning." (이재명 대통령이 8일 “매점매석은 망하는 길”이라며 “아직도 세상 변한 걸 모르고 구시대적 사고로 망하는 길을 가는 분들이 있어 미리 알려 드린다”고 말했다.)

The President posted on X (formerly Twitter) that day, saying, "Those who think they can make some money by hoarding will end up completely ruined. Under the law, if you engage in hoarding, all hoarded goods will be confiscated, and if confiscation is difficult, the equivalent amount will be collected. Because mandatory confiscation—in other words, obligatory seizure—is the rule, once you're caught, there's no room for leniency even if someone wanted to let you off." (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “돈 좀 벌어보겠다고 매점매석하다가는 완전히 망하게 된다”며 “법률상 매점매석을 하면 매점매석 대상인 물품 전체를 몰수하고, 몰수가 어려우면 그 가액을 추징한다. 필요적 몰수, 즉 몰수 추징이 의무이기 때문에 일단 발각되면 봐주고 싶어도 봐줄 수가 없다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "With the reward-for-reporting system offering 20–30% of the hoarded goods' value as a bounty, how could such actions go undetected? The era of abnormality is ending, and a normal era has begun. Those who try to take unfair profits by relying on abnormal practices will suffer greatly." (그러면서 “신고 포상제로 매점매석 물건 가액의 20~30%를 포상금으로 지급하는데 안 들킬 수가 있냐”며 “이제 비정상 시대는 저물고 정상시대가 시작됐다. 비정상에 기대 부당이익을 취하려다가는 큰 코 다친다”고 말했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Proposes Raising Age for Parental Consent on SNS from 14 to 16: "We Will Protect Children" (국힘 “SNS 가입시 보호자 동의, 만 14살→16살 상향 추진…아이들 지키겠다”)
item.description:
On the 8th, ahead of the June 3 local elections, the People Power Party announced detailed public welfare pledges focused on children and the elderly. The proposals include raising the age requiring parental consent for joining social networking services (SNS) from under 14 to under 16, and enabling the state to automatically contribute to the "Seedling Account," which helps children from vulnerable groups enter society, without requiring personal contributions. (국민의힘이 8일 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 어린이·어르신 밀착형 민생 공약을 발표했다. 현재 에스엔에스(SNS) 가입 시 보호자 동의가 필요한 나이를 만 14살 미만에서 만 16살 미만으로 올리고, 취약계층 아동의 사회진출을 돕는 ‘디딤씨앗통장’을 개인 부담 없이 국가가 자동 적립할 수 있도록 한다는 내용이다.)

Chung Jeom-sik, the policy chief of the People Power Party, said at a parliamentary strategy meeting held at the National Assembly on the 8th, "We will protect our children from harmful content and SNS addiction," adding, "We will mandate parental consent for teenagers under 16 when signing up for SNS, and push to limit exposure to addictive algorithms for harmful content such as drugs and gambling." Currently, the age limit requiring parental consent for SNS membership is under 14. He continued, "We will also work to expand children's libraries and care-based learning spaces, and improve the future educational environment by expanding English education using artificial intelligence (AI) programs." (정점식 국민의힘 정책위의장은 8일 국회에서 열린 원내대책회의에서 “우리 아이들을 유해 콘텐츠와 에스엔에스 중독으로부터 지키겠다”며 “만 16살 미만 청소년의 에스엔에스(SNS) 가입 시 보호자 동의를 의무화하고, 마약 도박 등 유해 콘텐츠 중독성 알고리즘 노출 제한을 추진하겠다”고 했다. 현재 에스엔에스 가입 시 보호자 동의가 필요한 나이 제한은 만 14살 미만이다. 이어 “어린이 도서관과 돌봄형 학습 공간을 확대하고 인공지능(AI) 프로그램을 활용한 영어 교육 확대 등 미래형 교육환경 개선에도 힘쓰겠다”고 했다.)

Chung also stated, "We will improve the 'Seedling Account,' which supports children from vulnerable groups in entering society, by transitioning it to an automatic state-funded accumulation system without personal burden. This will provide a monthly 100,000 won—amounting to 1.2 million won annually—to approximately 270,000 beneficiaries aged 17 or younger, as a foundation fund for independence." The Seedling Account is a government child asset-building support program that helps children in welfare facilities and similar groups prepare initial costs when they step into society. Currently, matching government funds are only available if the child, guardian, or a supporter makes an initial deposit. (정 정책위의장은 또, “취약계층 아동의 사회진출을 돕는 ‘디딤씨앗통장’을 개인 부담 없는 국가 자동 적립 방식으로 개선해 보상 대상 만 17살 이하 27만여명에게 월 10만원씩 매년 120만원의 자립 기반 자금을 지원하겠다”고 밝혔다. 디딤씨앗통장은 아동복지시설 보호아동 등이 사회에 진출할 때 필요한 초기비용 마련을 지원하는 정부의 아동자산형성지원사업으로, 아동 당사자나 보호자 혹은 지원자가 우선 적립하지 않으면 정부 매칭 지원금을 받을 수 없다.)

As pledges for the elderly, the People Power Party proposed introducing a new pneumococcal vaccine and a high-immunity influenza vaccine into the national vaccination program; expanding the national support age for shingles vaccination to "65 or older"; and expanding health insurance coverage for dental implants for those 65 and older (from 2 to 4 implants). (국민의힘은 어르신 공약으로는 △신규 폐렴구균 백신·고면역성 인플루엔자 국가 예방접종 도입 추진 △대상포진 국가지원 연령 ‘65살 이상’으로 확대 △65살 이상 어르신 임플란트 건강보험 적용 확대(2개→4개) 등을 제시했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr 유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "ACRC's No. 2 Confirmed to Have Bullied Deceased 'Director Kim'" …Request for Investigation by National Investigation Headquarters (“권익위 2인자, 숨진 ‘김 국장’ 괴롭힌 정황 확인”…국수본 수사의뢰)
item.description:
The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC) has decided to request an investigation from the National Investigation Headquarters (NIH) of the National Police Agency, which is already investigating the 'Kim Keon-hee luxury bag receiving case', citing procedural issues in its handling. The ACRC stated that it has confirmed circumstances where Jeong Seung-yoon, then Deputy Chairperson and Secretary-General of the ACRC, held an informal one-hour meeting with then-President Yoon Suk Yeol and others at the presidential residence late at night. (국민권익위원회(권익위)가 ‘김건희 명품가방 수수사건’ 처리와 관련해 절차에 문제가 있었다며 해당 사건을 수사 중인 경찰청 국가수사본부에 수사 의뢰하기로 했다. 권익위는 정승윤 당시 권익위 부위원장 겸 사무처장이 윤석열 전 대통령 등과 대통령 관저에서 심야시간에 1시간의 비공식 회동을 한 정황이 확인됐다고 밝혔다.)

The 'Task Force for Normalizing the ACRC' (TF) announced the results of its 54-day operation starting from March at the Government Seoul Complex on the 8th. The TF, under the instructions of newly appointed ACRC Chairperson Jeong Il-yeon in March, has re-investigated a total of five cases, including the Kim Keon-hee luxury bag case. (‘권익위 정상화 추진 태스크포스(TF·티에프는)’는 8일 정부서울청사에서 지난 3월부터 54일간의 운영 결과를 발표했다. 티에프는 지난 3월 임명된 정일연 신임 권익위원장의 지시로 김건희 명품백 사건' 등 모두 5가지 사건의 재조사를 벌여 왔다.)

Regarding the violation of the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act case related to former President Yoon's wife, Kim Keon-hee, receiving a luxury bag, the ACRC stated, "Former Secretary-General (Deputy Chairperson) Jeong delayed the case processing and held an informal meeting at the presidential residence during case processing, which may have violated the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act." According to the TF's investigation results, former Deputy Chairperson Jeong was also found to have convened an informal meeting with ACRC political appointees and standing commissioners two hours before the plenary committee meeting on June 10, 2024, to decide on the case handling, mentioning 'case closure' as the direction instead of referral or transmission to investigative agencies. (귄익위는 윤 전 대통령의 부인 김건희 여사의 명품가방 수수 관련 청탁금지법 위반 사건에 대해 “정 전 사무처장(부위원장)이 사건 처리를 지연하고 사건 처리 중 대통령 관저에서 비공식 회동을 하여 청탁금지법을 위반하였을 소지가 있다”고 밝혔다. 티에프 조사결과를 보면, 정 전 부위원장은 2024년 6월10일 해당 사건 처리를 결정할 권익위 전원위원회 회의 2시간 전 권익위 정무직·상임위원과 비공식 회의를 소집해 수사기관 이첩·송부 대신 ‘사건 종결’을 처리 방향으로 언급한 사실도 드러났다.)

Under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, the ACRC investigated Kim's receipt of the Dior bag for alleged violation of the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act, but closed the case as 'no violation' after 116 days, far exceeding the statutory processing period of 90 days. At the time, Deputy Chairperson Jeong stated, 'There are no sanctions for public officials' spouses' and 'We discussed whether it was related to (the president's) duties but closed it.' Criticism erupted that this gave a pass to the president and first lady under political pressure. (윤석열 정부 당시 권익위는 김 여사의 디올 가방 수수에 대해 청탁금지법 위반 혐의로 조사했지만, 법정처리기간 90일을 훌쩍 넘겨 116일 만에 사건을 ‘위반 사항 없음’으로 종결했다. 당시 정 부위원장은 ‘공직자 배우자는 제재 규정이 없다’ ‘(대통령의) 직무 관련성 여부를 논의했으나 종결했다’고 밝혔다. 당시 정치적 압박으로 대통령 부부에게 면죄부를 줬다는 비판이 터져 나왔다.)

The background of the suspicious closure of the first lady's case involving receipt of valuable goods for consideration is expected to be revealed through the police investigation. The ACRC explained that it requested former Deputy Chairperson Jeong's opinion on various suspicions via certified mail, but due to refusal to accept, etc., confirming the facts was difficult, leading to the request for investigation to the NIH. (대통령 부인의 대가성 금품 수수 사건이 석연치 않게 종결 처리된 배경은 경찰 수사를 통해 드러날 것으로 보인다. 권익위는 각종 의혹에 대해 정 전 부위원장에게 내용증명 우편 등을 통해 본인 의견을 요청했지만 수취거절 등으로 사실관계 확인이 어려워 이 사건을 수사 중인 국수본에 수사 의뢰하게 됐다고 설명했다.)

It was also stated that improper intervention by former Deputy Chairperson Jeong was confirmed in relation to the so-called 'civil complaint solicitation suspicions' of former Broadcasting and Communications Deliberation Committee Chairperson Ryu Hee-lim. The ACRC reported, "It was confirmed that former Secretary-General Jeong, violating ACRC rules, improperly instructed not to include the subcommittee's judgment and conclusions in the plenary agenda." (또 류희림 전 방송통신심의위원회 위원장의 이른바 ‘민원사주 의혹'과 관련해서도 정 전 부위원장의 부당한 개입이 확인됐다고 밝혔다. 권익위는 “정 전 사무처장이 권익위 규칙을 위반하여 전원위 안건에 분과위원회 판단내용 및 결론을 포함하지 않도록 부당하게 지시한 정황이 확인됐다”고 전했다.)

The TF also confirmed circumstances where former Deputy Chairperson Jeong bullied Kim Sang-nyeon, former ACRC Director of the Anti-Corruption Bureau, who was found dead in August 2024 after the case closure. It was previously reported through a Hankyoreh report that former Director Kim expressed severe self-loathing before his death over the case being closed as 'no legal violation.' (티에프는 정 전 부위원장이 이 사건 종결 처리 뒤인 2024년 8월 숨진 채 발견된 김상년 전 권익위 부패방지국장을 직장에서 괴롭힌 정황도 확인했다. 김 전 국장은 숨지기 전 이 사건이 ‘법률 위반 사항 없음’으로 종결 처리된 데 극심한 자괴감을 토로한 사실이 한겨레 보도를 통해 알려진 바 있다.)

ACRC Chairperson Jeong Il-yeon stated, "On behalf of the ACRC, I sincerely apologize to those involved in the case and the public who suffered due to decisions that did not meet public expectations," and said, "Especially as the Chairperson, I offer my apologies and condolences to the bereaved family of the late Director Kim Sang-nyeon, who dedicated his life to anti-corruption work." (정일연 권익위원장은 “국민 눈높이에 맞지 않은 결정으로 인해 고통을 받은 사건 관계자 및 국민 여러분께 권익위를 대표해 진심으로 사과 말씀을 드린다”며 ”특히 부패방지 업무에 평생을 매진해 온 고 김상년 국장의 유가족분들께 위원장으로서 사과와 위로의 말씀을 전한다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party to Filibuster All Bills, Including Constitutional Amendment, Until June 4 (국힘 “6월4일까지 개헌안 포함 모든 법안 필리버스터”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) announced on the 8th that it would hold unlimited debate (filibuster) on all bills, including a constitutional amendment, through June 4, the end of the current extraordinary session of the National Assembly. This is in response to National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik's announcement that day during a plenary session that he would proceed with a re-vote on the constitutional amendment and process 50 bills. (국민의힘이 8일 개헌안을 포함한 모든 법안에 이번 국회 임시회가 끝나는 다음달 4일까지 무제한토론(필리버스터)를 하겠다고 밝혔다. 우원식 국회의장이 이날 국회 본회의에서 개헌안 재투표와 법안 50건을 처리하겠다고 밝힌 데 대한 대응이다.)

PPP Floor Leader Song Eon-seok informed lawmakers that morning, "We will respond with unlimited debate to all agenda items brought to the plenary session, which is being convened unilaterally without agreement," and requested, "When the plenary session opens at 2 p.m., only lawmakers designated to speak in the unlimited debate and members of the 'plenary session guard' should enter the chamber." The party has already drawn up a roster for the 'plenary session guard' through June 4. ( 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 오전 의원들에게 “합의 없이 일방 개최되는 본회의에 상정되는 모든 안건에 대해 무제한토론으로 대응하겠다”며 “오후 2시 본회의가 개의되면 무제한토론 발언 의원 및 지킴조 의원님들만 본회의장에 입장해주기 바란다”고 공지했다. 이미 다음달 4일까지 ‘본회의장 지킴조’ 명단을 짜둔 상태다. )

There has been no precedent in constitutional history for a filibuster on a constitutional amendment. There has also been no precedent for a filibuster on every bill submitted. <<> Floor Leader Song argued that Speaker Woo's decision to put the constitutional amendment to a re-vote is itself an unconstitutional act. Speaking at the party's floor strategy meeting, Song stated, "The Constitutional Court has also ruled that, once the first vote concluded in the National Assembly and it was confirmed that quorum was not met, the assembly's decision was finalized as a rejection," and "Bringing a rejected bill back to the plenary session within the same term violates the principle of 'one subject, one session' (no reconsideration of a rejected bill)." <<> In response, the National Assembly Speaker's office told *The Hankyoreh* in a phone call, "The National Assembly has maintained the position that failure to meet the quorum for decision does not confirm the assembly's intent as rejection, and the 'one subject, one session' rule applies only when a rejection intent is confirmed," adding, "Based on this judgment, re-votes have been conducted when a vote fails to be established." <<> Article 92 of the National Assembly Act, the 'one subject, one session' clause, states that "a rejected bill cannot be re-initiated or submitted during the same term," meaning that cases where the vote itself was not established do not fall under this rule. <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr Reporter Choi Ha-yan jy@hani.co.kr ( 헌정 사상 개헌안에 대해 필리버스터가 진행된 사례는 없다. 상정되는 법안마다 필리버스터가 진행된 사례도 없다. )

item.title: President in Tears Pins Carnations on Chests of Parents of Fallen Firefighters and Police Officers (눈물 흘린 이 대통령, ‘순직 소방·경찰’ 부모 가슴에 카네이션)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung shed tears on Parents' Day, the 8th, while comforting the bereaved families of fallen public servants. (이재명 대통령이 어버이날인 8일 순직 공무원 유가족을 위로하며 눈물을 흘렸다.)

President Lee attended the 54th Parents' Day ceremony held at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul, and personally pinned carnations on the chests of 11 parents of firefighters and police officers who died in the line of duty serving the nation's safety, alongside First Lady Kim Hye-kyung. Overcome with emotion, President Lee wept, and the First Lady also shed tears as she embraced the bereaved families. This marked the first time the presidential couple attended a Parents' Day ceremony. The event, hosted by the Korean Senior Citizens Association, was attended by around 230 dignitaries, including Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae, Health and Welfare Minister Jeong Eun-kyung, and Korea Senior Citizens Association President Lee Joong-geun. <<> In his commemorative address, President Lee comforted the bereaved families by acknowledging the sacrifices of the fallen public servants. President Lee said, "This is a Parents' Day where we must share the warm hearts we have not conveyed. There are those who are in pain, longing for family members they can no longer meet," before his voice broke and he struggled to continue speaking for a while. Then, with a trembling voice, he added, "Here today, we are joined by the parents of public servants who sacrificed their lives protecting the people and left our side. I know well that no words can fully ease the sorrow of having to send away a beloved child first." As he read his speech, his voice would break off mid-sentence as if choked with emotion. President Lee stated, "At the most dangerous scenes, doing their duty to the very end, I will solemnly remember the noble sacrifice of those young people," and "I pinned carnations on the bereaved families today, with the resolve that the state will fulfill its 'filial duty' and responsibility, and protect them to the end." He added, "I wish health and peace to all parents on this land, including everyone here with us today." <<> Furthermore, President Lee said, "Rather than a society reliant on the one-sided sacrifices of parents, it is a society where the state and community share responsibility together," and "I believe that is the best filial piety to repay the hard work of our mothers and fathers." <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 서울 중구 대한상공회의소에서 열린 제54회 어버이날 기념식에 참석해 김혜경 여사와 함께 국민의 안전을 위해 봉사하다 순직한 소방·경찰 공무원 부모 11명의 가슴에 카네이션을 직접 달아줬다. 이 대통령은 감정이 복받친 듯 눈물을 흘렸고, 김 여사도 유족을 안아주며 눈물을 보였다. 이 대통령 부부가 어버이날 기념식에 참석한 것은 이번이 처음이다. 대한노인회가 주최한 이날 행사에는 정청래 더불어민주당 대표, 정은경 보건복지부 장관, 이중근 노인회장 등 각계 인사 230여명이 자리했다.)

item.title: [Photo] Consoling Parents of Fallen Officers… President Fights Back Tears ([포토] 순직 자녀 부모 위로…눈물 삼키는 이 대통령)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung attended the 54th Parents' Day ceremony on the 8th. This marks the first time a sitting president and first lady have jointly attended the Parents' Day ceremony. (이재명 대통령과 김혜경 여사가 8일 제54회 어버이날 기념식에 참석했다. 어버이날 기념식에 현직 대통령 부부가 함께 참석한 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

The ceremony, themed "With the Wings of Parental Love, We Bloomed into a Flower Called 'Us'," was organized by the Korean Senior Citizens Association (a corporation) and held at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul. ( ‘어버이 그 사랑의 날개로 우리라는 꽃을 피웠습니다’라는 주제로 사단법인 대한노인회가 연 이번 기념식은 서울시 중구 대한상공회의소에서 열렸다.)

Approximately 230 people attended the ceremony, including parents of firefighters and police officers who died while responding to and recovering from incidents such as the wildfires in Mungyeong, North Gyeongsang Province, and Gimje, North Jeolla Province, as well as exemplary filial piety practitioners and elderly individuals living alone. (기념식에는 경북 문경, 전북 김제 화재 등의 사고 수습·구조 과정에서 순직한 소방·경찰 공무원의 부모와 효행 실천 유공자, 독거노인 등 230여 명이 참석했다.)

Among them, President Lee and the First Lady personally pinned carnations on the parents of firefighters and police officers who died serving public safety, conveying messages of comfort, gratitude, and respect. The President was visibly emotional and shed tears, and Mrs. Kim also hugged the bereaved families, her eyes welling up. Here is a collection of photos from the scene provided by the Cheongwadae Press Corps. ( 이 대통령 부부는 이 가운데 국민의 안전을 위해 봉사하다 순직한 소방·경찰 공무원 부모의 가슴에 위로와 감사, 존경의 뜻을 담은 카네이션을 직접 달아줬다. 이 대통령은 감정이 복받친 듯 눈물을 흘렸고, 김 여사도 유족을 안아주며 눈물을 보였다. 청와대사진기자단이 보내온 현장의 사진을 모아본다.)

item.title: President Lee speaks with Canadian Prime Minister... discusses Middle East situation and energy supply (이 대통령, 캐나다 총리와 통화…중동상황·에너지 수급 논의)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung spoke with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on the 8th, reaching a consensus on the need for both countries to cooperate on the peaceful resolution of the Middle East situation and the guarantee of freedom in the Strait of Hormuz. (이재명 대통령이 8일 마크 카니 캐나다 총리와 통화하고 중동 상황의 평화적 해결과 호르무즈해협의 자유 보장 등을 위해 양국이 협력해 나가야 한다는 데 공감대를 이뤘다.)

Chief Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung stated in a written briefing that day, "As the bilateral relationship expands beyond security cooperation to encompass various fields including economy, energy, high-tech industries, and culture, both sides agreed to further deepen strategic cooperation based on this trend." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면브리핑을 통해 “양국 관계가 안보 협력을 넘어 경제, 에너지, 첨단산업, 문화를 아우르는 다방면으로 확대되고 있는 가운데 이러한 추세를 바탕으로 전략적 협력을 더욱 심화해 나가자는 데 의견을 모았다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee stated, "For South Korea, Canada is a key ally. Amid the recent complexity of the international order and instability in the global energy supply chain, I look forward to further strengthening cooperation between South Korea and Canada in various fields such as security, economy, energy, critical minerals, and high-tech industries." South Korea and Germany are currently competing to win the Canadian Patrol Submarine Project (CPSP), valued at up to 60 trillion won. In response, Prime Minister Carney expressed agreement with President Lee's remarks and replied, "It is important for middle-power countries like Canada and South Korea to strengthen solidarity under a more pragmatic approach." (이 대통령은 “한국에 있어서 캐나다는 핵심 우방국가이며, 최근 국제 질서가 복잡하고 글로벌 에너지 공급망이 불안정한 상황에서 한국과 캐나다가 안보, 경제, 에너지, 핵심광물, 첨단산업 등 다양한 분야에서의 협력을 더욱 강화해 나가기를 기대한다”고 밝혔다. 최대 60조원 규모 캐나다 초계 잠수함 프로젝트(CPSP) 수주를 두고 현재 우리나라와 독일이 경쟁하고 있다. 이에 카니 총리는 이 대통령의 언급에 공감을 표하며 “캐나다와 한국 등 중견국들이 보다 실용적인 접근 하에 연대를 강화하는 것이 중요하다”고 화답했다.)

Additionally, the two leaders agreed that both countries must work more closely together in the international community's efforts for the peaceful resolution of the Middle East situation, ensuring freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, and stable energy supply. (아울러 양 정상은 중동 상황의 평화적 해결과 호르무즈 해협 항행의 자유 보장, 안정적인 에너지 수급을 위한 국제사회의 노력에서도 양국이 더욱 긴밀히 협력해 나가야 한다는 점에 공감했다.)

Chief Spokesperson Kang stated, "The two leaders agreed to actively develop the bilateral relationship through frequent communication going forward," and "They decided to expedite consultations at various levels to achieve concrete and practical outcomes in diverse fields." (강 수석대변인은 “양 정상은 앞으로도 수시로 소통하면서 양국 관계를 적극 발전시켜 나가기로 했다”며 “앞으로 다양한 분야에서 구체적이고 실질적인 성과를 얻을 수 있도록 각급에서 속도감 있게 협의해 나가기로 했다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] Woo Won-shik "Suspends constitutional amendment process... Strongly regrets People Power Party" ([속보] 우원식 “개헌 절차 중단…국힘에 강력한 유감”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik declared at the plenary session of the National Assembly on the 8th, "I will not table the constitutional amendment bill." He further stated, "The procedures for the constitutional amendment implementation vote scheduled for June 3 have been halted as of today." (우원식 국회의장은 8일 국회 본회의에서 “헌법 개정안을 상정하지 않겠다”고 선언했다. 이어 “오는 6월3일 개헌 시행 투표를 위한 절차는 오늘로서 중단됐다”고 선언했다.)

Speaker Woo said, "Regarding this constitutional amendment, the first in 39 years—an amendment intended to prevent even the dream of martial law—the People Power Party refused to participate in the vote yesterday, causing it to fail, and today they said they would launch a filibuster. As the Speaker, I have no choice but to suspend all procedures," adding, "I cannot help but express strong regret toward the People Power Party." (우 의장은 “39년 만에 하는 헌법 개정안, 비상계엄을 꿈도 못 꾸게 하는 개헌안에 대해 국민의힘은 어제는 투표에 참여하지 않아 무산시키고, 오늘은 무제한 토론을 하겠다고 하니 의장으로서 모든 절차를 중단한다”며 “국민의힘에 강력한 유감을 표하지 않을 수 없다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yoon Suk Yeol and Anti-Corruption Deputy Chief Held Late-Night Meeting at Presidential Residence on Last Day of ‘Kim Keon Hee Luxury Bag Probe’ (윤석열-권익위 2인자, ‘김건희 명품백 조사’ 마감일 밤 대통령 관저서 만났다)
item.description:
It has been revealed that former President Yoon Suk Yeol and Jeong Seung-yoon, former Deputy Chair and Secretary-General of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC), held a late-night meeting at the presidential residence on the final day of the ACRC’s investigation into the ‘Kim Keon Hee luxury bag acceptance case.’ At the time, former President Yoon and his wife, Kim Keon Hee, were the subjects of the ACRC’s investigation, meaning the head of the public official corruption investigation agency met with those under investigation on the last day of the probe. Subsequently, the ACRC concluded the case as ‘no violation found,’ exceeding the statutory processing period of 60 days and taking 116 working days to close it. The ACRC has decided to request a police investigation into former Deputy Chair Jeong. <<> ACRC Chairperson Jeong Il-yeon announced on the 8th during a briefing on the results of the ‘ACRC Normalization Task Force (TF)’ operation, “It has been confirmed that on March 18, 2024, which was exactly the 60th day—the statutory reporting period under the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act—there was contact at the Hannam-dong presidential residence between former President Yoon and former Deputy Chair Jeong.” The ACRC did not announce its investigation results for about three months afterward, and on June 10, 2024, held a plenary committee meeting to decide to close the case, concluding there was no violation. At the time, criticism arose that the ACRC had granted immunity to the presidential couple, and the TF’s findings now raise suspicions that former President Yoon may have exerted influence behind the closure decision. This is expected to be clarified through police investigation. <<> Chairperson Jeong stated, “Contacting the parties involved in a case during the investigation process is itself an improper contact, and it raises suspicions about whether any other solicitations occurred during that contact,” and announced that he would request a police investigation by the National Investigation Headquarters into former Deputy Chair Jeong on charges of violating the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act. He added, “The part about the meeting at the residence was investigated based on statements from employees, such as the driver or those directly involved in or witnessing the meeting. It is not possible to know what was discussed during the contact. However, after the contact, there is a portion where [former Deputy Chair Jeong] made comments in the car, and an employee partly heard those remarks and responded to our TF investigation.” Regarding whether Kim Keon Hee was present at the meeting between former President Yoon and former Deputy Chair Jeong, Chairperson Jeong said, “That is a matter that should be investigated by the investigative authorities.” <<> Chairperson Jeong also stated that the ACRC’s closure of the ‘Kim Keon Hee luxury bag acceptance case’ during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration was itself a wrongful decision that went against the opinions of the working-level staff. He said, “The investigators’ opinions at the time were clearly different. It should not have been closed,” adding, “In the case of the luxury bag incident, the entire nation saw the case on television, and our ACRC’s decision resulted in a conclusion far different from what all the people witnessed, so we had no choice but to reflect on why such a decision was made.” The TF investigation revealed that former Deputy Chair Jeong, who led the closure decision during the plenary committee meeting, had gathered some members two hours before the meeting to pre-indicate the direction of closing the case. <<> Meanwhile, specific circumstances were also revealed showing that former Deputy Chair Jeong subjected the late Kim, then-head of the ACRC’s Anti-Corruption Bureau, to workplace harassment and many disadvantages. Kim had expressed severe self-loathing as the practical responsible official after the ACRC’s case closure decision and later died. Chairperson Jeong said, “In the process of handling the luxury bag case, [the late] former Bureau Director Kim, who held opinions different from those of the former Secretary-General [former Deputy Chair Jeong], suffered many disadvantages in various stages of the process. The specific details are so numerous that I cannot describe them one by one.” <<> Regarding specific details, Chairperson Jeong stated, “There were incidents where the deceased was suspected of ‘leaking internal information to the media or the National Assembly,’ and there were public criticisms against the deceased.” He added, “Employee statements and remarks made directly by the Secretary-General during expanded executive meetings are all recorded in documents.” <<> Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr (윤석열 전 대통령과 정승윤 전 국민권익위원회(권익위) 부위원장 겸 사무처장이 ‘김건희 명품 가방 수수 사건’의 권익위 조사 마감날에 ‘심야 대통령 관저 회동’을 한 사실이 드러났다. 윤 전 대통령은 아내인 김건희 여사와 함께 당시 권익위의 조사 대상이었는데 공직자 부패 조사 기관의 수뇌부가 사건 조사 마지막날에 조사 대상자를 만난 것이다. 그 뒤 권익위는 법정처리기간 60일을 넘겨 116일(업무일 기준) 만에 해당 사건을 ‘위반 사실 없음’으로 종결 처리했다. 권익위는 경찰에 정 전 부위원장에 대한 수사를 의뢰하기로 했다.)

item.title: Government Says 'No Plans to Conclude Korea-Japan Mutual Logistics Support Agreement'... Denying Japanese Media Reports (정부 “한-일 군수지원협정 체결 고려 안 해”…일 언론 보도 부인)
item.description:
In response to a report from Japanese media on the 8th claiming that the Japanese government aims to conclude an agreement for the mutual provision of military supplies between the Self-Defense Forces and the South Korean military, the South Korean government stated that it is "not considering the conclusion of such an agreement." A Mutual Logistics Support Agreement refers to a pact between nations allowing the exchange of military supplies such as ammunition, food, and fuel during emergencies. (일본 정부가 자위대와 한국군 간 군용 물자 상호 제공을 위한 협정 체결 등을 목표로 하고 있다는 8일 일본 언론의 보도에, 한국 정부는 “협정 체결을 고려하고 있지 않다”고 밝혔다. 상호군수지원협정은 유사시 탄약과 식량, 연료 등 군수 물자를 주고받을 수 있다는 국가 간 약속을 뜻한다.)

South Korea's First Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Park Yoon-joo, Vice Minister of National Defense Lee Doo-hee, Japan's Vice Minister for Foreign Affairs Takehiro Funakoshi, and Defense Counselor Koji Kano held the 14th Korea-Japan Security Policy Consultation, elevated to the vice-ministerial level, at the Seoul Foreign Ministry building on the 7th, discussing recent global developments and measures for exchange and cooperation between diplomatic and defense authorities. (박윤주 외교부 1차관과 이두희 국방부 차관, 일본의 후나코시 다케히로 외무사무차관과 가노 고지 방위심의관은 지난 7일 서울 외교부 청사에서 차관급으로 격상된 제14차 한일 안보정책협의회를 열어 최근의 글로벌 정세와 외교·국방 당국 간 교류·협력 방안을 논의했다.)

Japan's Yomiuri Shimbun reported that the Japanese government aims to achieve concrete outcomes, including the conclusion of an Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA) for material cooperation between the South Korean military and the Self-Defense Forces. Japan expects that establishing institutions such as a Reciprocal Access Agreement (RAA) for expanding joint defense drills will enhance trilateral security ties among South Korea, the U.S., and Japan, thereby improving deterrence against military provocations from North Korea and China. (일본 요미우리신문은 일본 정부가 향후 한국군과 자위대 간 물자 협력을 위한 상호군수지원협정(ACSA) 체결 등 구체적 성과를 내는 것을 목표로 하고 있다고 보도했다. 한일 양국이 공동 방위훈련 확충을 위한 협정(RAA) 등을 포함한 제도를 갖추면 한미일 군사적 연계 향상으로 북한과 중국 군사 도발 억지력이 향상될 것으로 일본 쪽은 기대하고 있다.)

A Japanese Defense Ministry official told the Nikkei, "It is highly significant that we were able to hold (the Korea-Japan Security Policy Consultation) at this timing to link U.S. attention to East Asia." (일본 방위성 간부는 니혼게이자이신문(닛케이)에 “미국의 관심을 동아시아에 연결하기 위해 지금 타이밍에 (한일 안보정책협의회를) 개최할 수 있었던 데는 의의가 크다”고 말했다.)

However, the South Korean government maintains its stance of not considering the conclusion of a Mutual Logistics Support Agreement with Japan, leaving the progress of discussions uncertain. A Ministry of National Defense official stated, "Our government is conducting stable and future-oriented defense exchange and cooperation based on mutual respect and trust with Japan," but added, "We are not considering the conclusion of a Korea-Japan ACSA." (다만, 한국 정부는 일본과의 상호군수지원협정 체결은 검토하지 않는다는 입장을 유지하고 있어 논의가 진척될지는 미지수다. 국방부 관계자는 “우리 정부는 일본과 상호 존중과 신뢰를 바탕으로 안정적이고 미래지향적인 국방교류협력을 실시해 나가고 있다”면서도 “한일 상호군수지원협정(ACSA) 체결은 고려하고 있지 않다”고 말했다.)

South Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that in this meeting, both sides confirmed a shared recognition that cooperation between Korea and Japan, as well as among Korea, the U.S., and Japan, is becoming increasingly important amid the deepening severity of the international situation, and agreed to maintain ongoing communication to advance this. Previously, President Lee Jae-myung and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi shared an acknowledgment of the importance of Korea-Japan and Korea-U.S.-Japan security cooperation during their summit meeting in Nara Prefecture, Japan, in January. (한국 외교부는 이번 회의에서 국제정세가 나날이 엄중해지고 있는 현 상황에서 한일·한미일 간 협력이 더욱 중요해지고 있다는 공통된 인식을 확인하고, 이를 진전시켜 나가기 위해 지속 소통해 나가기로 했다고 밝혔다. 앞서, 이재명 대통령과 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리는 지난 1월 일본 나라현에서 열린 정상회담에서 한일·한미일 안보 협력 중요성에 대한 인식을 공유한 바 있다.)

During the administration of President Lee Myung-bak, the conclusion of a General Security of Military Information Agreement (GSOMIA) between Korea and Japan was followed by consideration of a Mutual Logistics Support Agreement. However, when the GSOMIA fell through just before signing due to public opposition, the Mutual Logistics Support Agreement was also put on hold. The Korea-Japan GSOMIA was eventually signed under the Park Geun-hye administration, but the government still draws a clear line against concluding a Mutual Logistics Support Agreement. (이명박 정부 당시 한일 간 군사정보보호협정(GSOMIA)에 이어 상호군수지원협정 체결도 검토된 적이 있다. 하지만, 군사정보보호협정이 반대 여론으로 체결 직전 무산되면서 상호군수지원협정도 보류됐다. 한일 군사정보보호협정은 박근혜 정부 때 결국 체결됐으나, 정부는 상호군수지원협정 체결에는 여전히 선을 긋고 있다.)

The Yomiuri reported, citing government officials from both sides, that "as a result of Japan's colonial rule, there is a sense of aversion to the Self-Defense Forces in South Korea," and that President Lee mentioned in the January summit that "security cooperation needs to proceed while taking public sentiment into account." (요미우리는 “일본 식민지배의 결과, 한국에 자위대에 대한 거부감이 있다”며 이 대통령이 1월 정상회담에서 “안보협력은 국민 정서를 배려하면서 진행할 필요가 있다”고 언급했다고 양국 정부 관계자를 인용해 전했다.)

Nevertheless, with high-level exchange schedules between the two countries likely to follow, such as a potential visit to South Korea by Prime Minister Takaichi and Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi later this month or next month, discussions on advancing security cooperation are likely to continue. (다만, 이달 하순 또는 다음달 다카이치 총리와 고이즈미 신지로 일본 방위상의 방한이 추진되는 등 앞으로 양국 간 고위급 교류 일정이 잇따를 가능성이 있는 만큼 안보협력 진전 문제가 계속해서 논의될 가능성이 있다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Strategically Nominates Attorney Kim Young-bin for Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang in Chungnam… '4th Recruited Talent' (민주, 충남 공주·부여·청양 후보에 김영빈 변호사 전략공천…‘영입인재 4호’)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 8th that it has strategically nominated attorney Kim Young-bin as the candidate for the National Assembly by-election in the Chungnam districts of Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, held alongside the June 3 local elections. With this, the Democratic Party has completed the nomination of candidates for all 14 constituencies in this by-election. (더불어민주당은 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 국회의원 보궐선거 충남 공주·부여·청양 후보로 김영빈 변호사를 전략공천한다고 8일 밝혔다. 이로써 민주당은 이번 14개 지역구 재보궐 선거 후보 공천을 모두 마무리했다.)

Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae held a talent recruitment ceremony at the National Assembly on the same day and announced the recruitment of Kim, a former prosecutor, as the '4th talent'. Jeong stated, "Attorney Kim was born in Gongju and attended elementary, middle, and high school all in Gongju—he is a person of Gongju and Chungcheong Province to the core," adding, "He later dedicated himself to correcting societal injustices and upholding justice through 10 years of service as a prosecutor." (정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 국회에서 인재 영입식을 열고 검사 출신인 김 변호사를 ‘4호 인재’로 영입한다고 밝혔다. 정 대표는 “김 변호사는 공주에서 태어나 초·중·고를 모두 공주에서 나온 뼛속까지 공주 사람, 충청도 사람”이라며 “이후 10년간 검사 생활을 통해 세상의 부조리를 바로잡고 정의를 바로 세우기 위해 헌신했다”고 말했다.)

Jeong further introduced, "From 2019 to 2021, as a policy advisor to the Minister of Justice, he made significant contributions to the establishment and enactment of prosecution reform plans, including human rights protection investigations and a full organizational overhaul," and "He expanded the authority and role of the Civilian Prosecutorial Review Committee, enhancing judicial transparency and democracy through citizen participation." (정 대표는 “(김 변호사가) 특히 2019년부터 2021년까지는 법무부 장관을 (정책보좌관으로서) 보좌해 인권 보호 수사, 조직 전면 개편 등 검찰개혁안의 수립·제정에 많은 공로를 세웠다”며 “검찰시민위원회의 권한과 역할을 확대하고 시민 참여를 통한 사법 투명성과 민주성을 한층 더 높였다”고 소개했다.)

Attorney Kim said, "Having completed all my schooling from elementary to high school in Gongju, Chungnam, I have the sentiment of a Chungnam native to my core," and added, "In particular, solidarity with candidate Park Soo-hyun (the Democratic Party candidate for Chungnam governor) is the most powerful alliance for the development of our region." He introduced himself by saying, "I have devoted my practical capabilities to laying the groundwork for democratic judicial control, such as the reasonable adjustment of investigative powers and a full-scale overhaul of human rights protection systems, which are the foundations of the prosecution reform led by the party." (김 변호사는 “충남 공주에서 초중고를 모두 마쳐 뼛속까지 충남 사람 정서”라며 “특히 (민주당 충남지사 후보인) 박수현 후보와 연대는 우리 지역 발전을 위한 가장 강력한 연대”라고 말했다. 이어 김 변호사는 “당이 주도하는 검찰개혁의 근간이 되는 수사권의 합리적 조정과 인권 보호제도 전면 개편 등 민주적 사법 통제 기틀을 다지는 데 실무적 역량을 쏟았다”고 자신을 소개했다.)

Immediately after the talent recruitment ceremony for Attorney Kim, the Democratic Party convened a strategic nomination management committee and strategically nominated him as the candidate for Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang. These districts became vacant following former lawmaker Park Soo-hyun's candidacy for Chungnam governor, leading to a by-election concurrent with the local elections. (민주당은 김 변호사 인재 영입식을 마친 직후 전략공천관리위원회를 열어 그를 공주·부여·청양 후보로 전략공천했다. 공주·부여·청양은 박수현 전 의원의 충남지사 출마로 공석이 돼 지방선거와 함께 보궐 선거가 치러진다.)

With Kim's nomination concluded, the Democratic Party has finalized candidate decisions for all 14 National Assembly by-election districts. The party plans to launch the 'National Normalization of the Republic of Korea' central election committee on the 10th. Jeong Cheong-rae will serve as the standing co-chair of the election committee. They plan to recruit external figures for the joint standing co-chair positions. (김 변호사 공천을 마지막으로 민주당은 14개 국회의원 재보궐선거 지역 후보 결정을 마무리했다. 민주당은 오는 10일 ‘대한민국 국가 정상화’ 중앙선거대책위원회를 발족할 예정이다. 정청래 대표가 상임 선대위원장을 맡는다. 공동 상임선대위원장은 외부 인사를 영입할 계획이다.)

Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Manlijae Photo Album] National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik Sheds Tears Over Failed Constitutional Amendment After 39 Years ([만리재사진첩] 우원식 의장, ‘39년 만의 개헌’ 무산에 눈물)
item.description:
"Bang, bang, bang!" (“땅,땅,땅!”)

The gavel struck the podium with force as the session was adjourned, cutting through the air. National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik's expression was hardened, and the hammer carried his anger. It was already after all lawmakers from the People Power Party had left. (산회를 선언하며 의장석에서 강하게 내려치는 의사봉이 허공을 갈랐다. 우원식 국회의장의 표정은 굳었고 망치에는 분노가 담겨있었다. 이미 국민의힘 의원들은 모두 퇴장하고 난 뒤였다.)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik declared the adjournment of the plenary session on the 8th, protesting the People Power Party's request for a filibuster (unlimited debate to legally obstruct proceedings) regarding the constitutional amendment. (우원식 국회의장은 8일 본회의에서 국민의힘의 헌법 개정안에 대한 필리버스터(합법적 의사진행 방해를 위한 무제한토론) 신청에 반발하며 산회를 선포했다.)

On that day, the National Assembly planned to reattempt the vote on the constitutional amendment, which had failed due to the People Power Party's absence the previous day, and to process 50 non-contentious bills. However, after the People Power Party announced a filibuster not only on the constitutional amendment but also on the non-contentious bills, Speaker Woo opposed this and declared the session adjourned. (이날 국회는 전날 국민의힘 불참으로 투표불성립 된 개헌안 표결을 재시도하고, 50개 비쟁점법안들을 처리할 예정이었다. 하지만 국민의힘이 개헌안은 물론 비쟁점법안들까지 필리버스터를 예고하자 우 의장이 반발하며 산회를 선언한 것이다.)

Before adjourning the session, Speaker Woo delivered remarks, saying, "I reconvened the plenary session today in an effort to avoid derailing the first constitutional amendment in 39 years. But seeing the People Power Party respond with a filibuster, I feel that continuing the proceedings is futile," as he shed tears. He also criticized the People Power Party's claim of a "hasty amendment," referencing his proposal for constitutional amendment discussions in his Liberation Day speech on July 17, 2024, and pointed out, "The Speaker made numerous suggestions all along, and it was the People Power Party that rejected and ignored them each time." He then declared, "I will not table the constitutional amendment," and added, "The process for the national referendum scheduled for June 3 has been halted as of today." He further issued harsh remarks toward the People Power Party, saying, "I hope they feel ashamed and afraid," and "I feel bursting with resentment and on the verge of tears." (우 의장은 산회를 선언하기 전 모두발언을 통해 “어떻게든 39년 만에 개헌을 무산시키지 않기 위해 오늘 다시 본회의를 열었다”며 “그런데 (국민의힘이) 필리버스터로 응답하는 것을 보니 더 이상 의사진행이 소용이 없겠다는 생각이 든다”며 눈물을 보였다. 그는 또 그는 ‘졸속 개헌’이라는 국민의힘 주장에 대해서는 2024년 7월17일 제헌절 경축사를 통해 여야에 개헌 논의를 제안한 사실을 거론하며 “그동안 의장이 숱하게 제언했는데, 그때마다 거부하고 대답하지 않은 게 국민의힘”이라고 꼬집었다. 이어 “의장은 헌법 개정안을 상정하지 않겠다”며 “오는 6월 3일 국민투표 시행을 위한 절차는 오늘로써 중단됐다”고 선언했다. 그러면서 "부끄럽게 두렵게 여기길 바란다”, "분통이 터지고 눈물이 나올 것 같다” 등 국민의힘을 향한 작심 발언을 쏟아냈다.)

Song Eon-seok, the floor leader of the People Power Party, who was scheduled to be the first to engage in unlimited debate, requested that the agenda be put forward but walked out mid-speech after Speaker Woo made strong remarks of regret, and the plenary session hall echoed with raised voices from lawmakers of both parties. (첫번째 무제한 토론자로 나설 예정이었던 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 우 의장이 강한 유감을 내용으로 하는 모두발언을 하자 안건 상정을 요구하다 중간에 퇴장했고 여야 의원간의 고성이 본회의장을 채웠다.)

Yoon Woon-sik, Senior Reporter yws@hani.co.kr (윤운식 선임기자yws@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Presidential Office: "Public demand to reflect lessons of illegal martial law in constitution thwarted by People Power Party opposition, regrettable" (청와대 “불법계엄 교훈 헌법 반영하자는 국민 요구, 국힘 반대로 무산돼 유감”)
item.description:
Regarding the final failure to pass the constitutional amendment bill in the National Assembly plenary session due to opposition from the People Power Party, the Presidential Office stated that "discussions on constitutional amendment, which were promised to the people, must never be halted." (청와대가 헌법개정안(개헌안) 국회 본회의 처리가 국민의힘 반대로 최종 무산된 것과 관련해 “국민께 약속했던 개헌 논의가 결코 중단돼서는 안 된다”는 입장을 밝혔다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong said in a written briefing on the 8th, "We express regret that the plenary session's handling of the constitutional amendment bill ultimately failed due to opposition from lawmakers of the People Power Party." National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik had planned to hold a plenary session that day to hold a revote on the amendment, but after the People Power Party announced it would filibuster all bills, including the constitutional amendment, until the end of the current extraordinary session on the 4th of next month, he declared that "the constitutional amendment bill will not be put on the agenda." This scuttled the push for a national referendum on the constitutional amendment, which was intended to coincide with the June 3 local elections. The constitutional amendment bill had also been tabled for the plenary session the previous day, but the People Power Party's boycott of the vote prevented it from meeting the quorum (approval by more than two-thirds of registered lawmakers), so no vote was held. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 8일 서면브리핑을 내어 “헌법개정안 본회의 처리가 국민의힘 소속 국회의원들의 반대로 끝내 무산된 데 대해 유감을 표한다”며 이렇게 말했다. 우원식 국회의장은 이날 본회의를 열어 개헌안을 재표결할 예정이었으나, 국민의힘이 개헌안을 포함한 모든 법안에 대해 이번 국회 임시회가 끝나는 다음달 4일까지 무제한토론(필리버스터)을 하겠다고 나서자 “헌법 개정안을 상정하지 않겠다”고 선언했다. 이로써 6·3 지방선거와 동시에 실시하려던 개헌안 국민 투표 추진은 무산됐다. 개헌안은 전날에도 국회 본회의에 상정됐지만 국민의힘의 표결 불참으로 의결정족수(재적 의원 3분의 2 이상 찬성)가 미달해 표결 자체가 이뤄지지 못했다.)

Spokesperson Kang said, "This constitutional amendment includes incorporating the spirit of the Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement into the preamble, and strengthening the state's responsibility for balanced regional development and the National Assembly's control over martial law." She added, "It was a public demand to reflect the lessons of the December 3 illegal martial law incident in the constitution, and there was no major disagreement between the ruling and opposition parties." She then indirectly criticized the opposition party, saying, "The people will find it hard to understand why even the minimal constitutional amendment to protect the nation's security and democracy was opposed." (강 대변인은 “이번 개헌안은 헌법 전문에 부마민주항쟁과 5·18 민주화운동 정신을 담고, 국가의 지역균형발전 책임과 계엄에 대한 국회의 통제 권한 강화를 명시하는 내용을 담고 있다”라며 “지난 12·3 불법계엄 사태의 교훈을 헌법에 반영하자는 국민적 요구였으며 여야 간 큰 이견도 없었다”고 했다. 이어 “국민들은 국가의 안위와 민주주의를 지키기 위한 최소한의 개헌마저 반대한 이유를 납득하기 어려우실 것”이라며 야당을 에둘러 비판했다.)

Spokesperson Kang stated, "We request that discussions on constitutional amendment continue with a more responsible attitude in the second half of the National Assembly, keeping the promise to the people." She added, "Constitutional amendment is not just about changing institutions. It should be a new starting point to overcome extreme confrontation and partisan strife, and restore consensus politics, national unity, and social harmony." She further said, "The Presidential Office will continue to unwaveringly push forward discussions on constitutional amendment, a task of the times, together with the people." (강 대변인은 “후반기 국회에 보다 책임 있는 자세로 개헌 논의를 이어가며 국민과의 약속을 지켜주시길 요청드린다”고 말했다. 강 대변인은 “개헌은 단지 제도를 고치는 문제가 아니다. 극한 대립과 정쟁을 넘어 협의 정치와 국민 통합, 사회적 화합을 복원하는 새로운 출발점이 돼야 한다”라며 “청와대는 앞으로도 시대적 과제인 개헌 논의를 국민과 함께 흔들림 없이 추진해 나가겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Getting More Outrageous by the Day... 'Martial Law Troops' Kim Hyun-tae to Run for Incheon Gyeyang-eul, Jeon Han-gil to Launch Party After Local Elections (갈수록 가관…‘계엄군’ 김현태 “인천 계양을 출마”, 전한길 “지선 뒤 창당”)
item.description:
Kim Hyun-tae, former commander of the 707th Special Mission Group under the Republic of Korea Army Special Warfare Command, who is on trial for leading troops to infiltrate the main building of the National Assembly during the December 3 martial law incident, declared his candidacy for the Incheon Gyeyang-eul by-election, vowing to "bring down the Lee Jae-myung regime." Kim added, "I will inherit the spirit of Founding President Syngman Rhee, who blossomed liberal democracy, and continue the spirit of President Park Chung-hee, who lived only for the nation and its people. item.title: Namu-ho Docks at Dubai Port… Investigation into Cause of Explosion and Fire Full-Scale (나무호, 두바이항 입항…폭발·화재 원인 규명 본격화)
item.description:
The HMM cargo ship "Namu-ho," which suffered an explosion and fire while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, docked at Dubai Port in the United Arab Emirates on the 8th, marking the start of a full-scale investigation into the cause of the accident. The government stated that the Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal's on-site investigation is expected to begin as early as 3:00 PM Korean time, but noted it may be flexible depending on local conditions. (호르무즈해협에 정박 중 폭발·화재가 발생한 에이치엠엠(HMM) 화물선 ‘나무호’가 8일 아랍에미리트(UAE) 두바이항에 입항해 사고 원인 규명이 본격화한다. 정부는 이날 해양안전심판원의 현지 조사가 한국시각으로 이르면 오후 3시 시작될 것으로 예상하며, 현지 사정에 따라 유동적이라고 밝혔다.)

The Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal dispatched investigators to the site to determine the cause of the fire. Under the Marine Accident Investigation Act, procedures such as ship inspection, crew interviews, and review of relevant materials will be conducted. The key is to clarify whether the explosion and fire resulted from an external attack or an internal factor. A government official said, "If needed to determine the cause of the accident after the investigation, a trial will proceed based on the investigator's request for a ruling." (해양안전심판원은 화재 원인 규명을 위해 조사관을 현지에 파견했다. 해양사고심판법에 따라 선박 확인과 선원 면담, 관련 자료 조사 등이 이뤄질 예정이다. 폭발과 화재가 외부 공격에 의한 것인지, 내부 요인에 의한 것인지를 밝히는 게 핵심이다. 정부 관계자는 “조사 이후 사고 원인 규명(확정)이 필요한 경우, 사고 조사관의 심판 청구에 따라 심판을 진행하게 된다”고 밝혔다.)

Earlier, at around 8:40 PM on the 4th, an explosion and fire occurred in the engine room of the Namu-ho while it was anchored in waters near the United Arab Emirates inside the Strait of Hormuz. Initially, the South Korean government leaned towards the possibility of an attack, but National Security Office Director Seo Yong-rak stated on the 6th, "The possibility of an attack was mentioned early on, but after reviewing additional information, it appears uncertain." (앞서, 지난 4일 오후 8시40분께 호르무즈해협 안쪽 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에 정박해 있던 나무호 기관실에서 폭발과 화재가 발생했다. 애초 우리 정부는 피격 가능성에 무게를 뒀지만, 위성락 국가안보실장은 지난 6일 “초기에 피격 가능성이 거론됐는데, 정보를 추가 검토해보니 피격이 확실하지 않은 것 같다”고 말했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Another attempt at constitutional amendment in 39 years fails… Speaker Woo Won-shik says, "PPP kicked away both the opportunity and the responsibility" (39년 만 개헌 시도 또 무산…우원식 의장 “국힘, 기회도 책임도 걷어차”)
item.description:
The National Assembly attempted again on the 8th to process the constitutional amendment bill that had failed the previous day due to a lack of quorum for voting, but the bill's submission was thwarted after the People Power Party (PPP) announced it would counter with a filibuster (unlimited debate). The attempt to amend the 39-year-old constitution has once again failed. (국회가 8일 전날 투표 불성립으로 무산된 헌법 개정안(개헌안) 처리를 다시 시도했지만 국민의힘이 필리버스터(무제한 토론)로 맞대응을 예고하면서 개헌안 상정이 불발됐다. 39년 된 헌법을 바꾸려는 시도는 또다시 무산됐다.)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik declared during the plenary session that day, "I will not submit the constitutional amendment bill," adding, "The procedures for holding a national referendum on the constitutional amendment on June 3 have been suspended as of today." This came in response to the PPP's announcement that morning that it would conduct a filibuster (unlimited debate) on all bills, including the constitutional amendment bill, until the 4th of next month when the extraordinary parliamentary session ends. (우원식 국회의장은 이날 열린 국회 본회의에서 “헌법 개정안을 상정하지 않겠다”며 “오는 6월3일 개헌 국민투표 시행을 위한 절차는 오늘로써 중단됐다”고 선언했다. 이는 이날 오전 국민의힘이 개헌안을 포함한 모든 법안에 국회 임시회가 끝나는 다음달 4일까지 무제한토론(필리버스터)를 하겠다고 나온 것에 따른 것이다.)

Speaker Woo stated, "We couldn't even open the door for constitutional amendment on a bill that could have been easily agreed upon between the ruling and opposition parties, with practically no opposition to its content. I cannot help but express strong regret toward the People Power Party, which has caused the constitutional amendment to fail after 39 years." He further criticized the PPP, saying, "The People Power Party not only kicked away the barely created opportunity for constitutional amendment but also kicked away the responsibility to fulfill the promises made to the people as a party." Speaker Woo was seen wiping away tears as he declared the session adjourned and stepped down from the podium. (우 의장은 “여야 간에 얼마든지 합의가 가능한, 사실상 내용에 반대가 전혀 없는 개헌안을 놓고도 개헌의 문을 열지 못했다”라며 “39년 만에 개헌을 무산시킨 국민의힘에 강력한 유감을 표명하지 않을 수 없다”라고 말했다. 이어 “국민의힘은 가까스로 만든 개헌 기회를 걷어찼을 뿐 아니라 공당으로서 국민께 한 약속을 실천하는 책임도 같이 걷어찬 것”이라고 국민의힘을 비판했다. 우 의장은 산회를 선포하고 연단을 내려오면서 눈물을 훔치기도 했다.)

The constitutional amendment bill, proposed by the six parties excluding the PPP—namely the Democratic Party of Korea, the Rebuilding Korea Party, the Progressive Party, the Reform Party, the Basic Income Party, and the Social Democratic Party—includes provisions such as: stipulating the Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement in the preamble of the constitution; introducing the National Assembly's approval authority over martial law and strengthening the Assembly's request for martial law lift into full lift power; and clarifying the state's duty to resolve regional disparities and promote balanced development. The bill was submitted to the plenary session the previous day, but all PPP lawmakers boycotted the vote, resulting in a quorum not being met and the vote failing. (국민의힘을 뺀 더불어민주당, 조국혁신당, 진보당, 개혁신당, 기본소득당, 사회민주당 등 6개 정당이 발의한 개헌안은 △부마민주항쟁과 5·18민주화운동을 헌법 전문에 명시 △계엄에 대한 국회의 승인권을 도입하고, 국회의 계엄해제요구권을 계엄해제권으로 강화 △국가의 지역 간 격차 해소와 균형발전 의무를 명시 등의 내용을 담고 있다. 전날 본회의에 상정됐으나 국민의힘 의원 전원이 투표에 불참하면서 의결 정족수 미달로 투표가 성립되지 않았다.)

To hold a national referendum on the constitutional amendment concurrently with the June 3 local elections, the amendment bill must pass the National Assembly by the 10th. With the failure to submit the bill on this day, the attempt at constitutional amendment has effectively collapsed. In May 2018, a constitutional amendment bill proposed by then-President Moon Jae-in also failed to pass the National Assembly due to a lack of quorum caused by the boycott of four opposition parties. (개헌에 대한 찬반을 묻는 국민투표를 6·3 지방선거와 함께 실시하려면 오는 10일까지 개헌안이 국회를 통과해야 하는데 이날 개헌안 상정 불발로 개헌 시도는 사실상 무산됐다. 2018년 5월 문재인 당시 대통령이 내놓은 개헌안도 야 4당의 표결 불참에 따른 의결정족수 미달로 투표가 성립되지 않아 국회 본회의 문턱을 넘지 못한 바 있다.)

After the session was adjourned, PPP floor leader Song Eon-seok met with reporters and said, "The National Assembly Speaker unilaterally convened the plenary session without agreement between the negotiating groups, leaving our party no choice but to respond with a filibuster." Floor leader Song also directed sharp criticisms at President Lee Jae-myung, Speaker Woo Won-sik, and the Democratic Party, asking, "Did you have any intention to amend the constitution? Or perhaps you needed a record of the People Power Party opposing it when you pushed the amendment bill through without bipartisan agreement?" He added, "Wasn't there an ulterior motive to frame us as a party that defends martial law and gain an advantageous position in the local elections?" Furthermore, Floor leader Song stated, "We do not fundamentally oppose including the Busan-Masan Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement in the constitutional preamble," but added, "Regarding the nation's founding, it should be included in the constitution, and the Saemaul Undong and modernization should also be fully incorporated." (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 산회 이후 기자들과 만나 “국회의장이 교섭단체 간 합의 없이 일방적으로 (본회의를) 개최해 우리 당은 할 수 없이 필리버스터로 대응할 수밖에 없던 상태”라고 했다. 송 원내대표는 이재명 대통령, 우원식 의장과 민주당을 향해 “개헌 의지가 있었냐. 혹시 개헌안을 여야 합의 없이 강행하면서 국민의힘이 반대했다는 기록이 필요했던 것 아니냐”며 “계엄 옹호 정당이라는 고약한 프레임 뒤집어씌워서 지방선거에서 유리한 고지를 점하려는 저의가 있었던 것 아니냐”고 날을 세우기도 했다. 아울러 송 원내대표는 “부마항쟁, 5·18민주화운동 등을 헌법 전문 수록에 담는 데 대해 근본적으로 반대하지 않는다”면서도 “건국과 관련해 헌법에 넣어야 하고 새마을운동, 근대화 관련해서도 다 헌법에 포함해야 한다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party and the presidential office attributed the failure to process the constitutional amendment bill to the People Power Party. Deputy spokesperson Deputy Seung-chan of the Democratic Party issued a statement shortly after the session adjourned, saying, "Is it so frightening to enshrine the severance from the December 3 insurrection in the constitution?" and added, "We will achieve the constitutional amendment. We urge the cooperation of the People Power Party." (민주당과 청와대는 개헌안 처리 불발의 책임을 국민의힘으로 돌렸다. 부승찬 민주당 대변인은 산회 직후 입장을 내어 “12·3 내란과의 단절을 헌법에 새기는 것이 그토록 두려운 것이냐”라며 “개헌을 반드시 이뤄내겠다. 국민의힘의 협조를 촉구한다”고 밝혔다.)

Senior Presidential Secretary for Press Affairs Kang Yu-jung stated at a written briefing that day, "We express regret that the processing of the constitutional amendment bill in the plenary session ultimately failed due to opposition from lawmakers of the People Power Party." She added, "The discussion on constitutional amendment, as promised to the people, must never be halted. We request that the later part of the National Assembly session continue broader discussions on constitutional reform with a more responsible attitude and keep the promises made to the public." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면브리핑을 통해 “헌법개정안 본회의 처리가 국민의힘 소속 국회의원들의 반대로 끝내 무산된 데 대해 유감을 표한다”며 “국민께 약속했던 개헌 논의가 결코 중단되어서는 안 된다. 후반기 국회에 보다 책임 있는 자세로 개헌 논의를 이어가며 국민과의 약속을 지켜주시길 요청드린다”고 말했다.)

There are also voices calling for both parties to take responsibility for the failure to process the constitutional amendment bill. Han Sang-hee, a professor at Konkuk University's Law School and co-chair of the Citizen-Led Constitutional Amendment National Network (Citizen Constitutional Net), expressed regret, saying, "I thought this process (of the phased constitutional amendment bill) was a meaningful step to open the door for constitutional reform, but it has been frustrated." Professor Han pointed out, "The PPP's act of depriving the people of the opportunity to discuss and contemplate the constitutional amendment through a national referendum is anti-democratic," and also criticized the Democratic Party, noting, "There was a lack of effort to pass the amendment bill, gather public support, and sway PPP lawmakers based on that effort." (개헌안 처리 불발에 양당 모두 책임감을 가져야 한다는 목소리도 나온다. 시민주도 헌법개정 전국네트워크(시민개헌넷)의 공동대표를 맡은 한상희 건국대 법학전문대학원 교수는 “개헌의 물꼬를 트기 위한 계기로서 (이번 단계적 개헌안 처리가) 의미가 있는 절차라고 생각했는데 좌절됐다”라고 아쉬움을 표했다. 한 교수는 “국민들이 국민투표를 통해 개헌에 대해 논의하고 고민할 기회를 박탈한 국민의힘의 행위는 반민주적“이라며 민주당을 향해서도 “개헌안을 통과시키려는 노력, 국민들의 지지를 모으고 그 노력을 바탕으로 국민의힘 의원들을 끌어들이려는 노력이 없었다”라고 지적했다.)

Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee and First Lady Make Surprise Visit to Namdaemun Market to Encourage Merchants Affected by Economic Downturn (이 대통령 부부, 남대문시장 깜짝 방문…경기 위축 상인들 격려)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung visited Namdaemun Market in Seoul on the 8th to encourage merchants who have been struggling due to the economic contraction caused by the wars involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. <<> The presidential spokesperson, Ahn Gwi-ryeong, reported that President Lee and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung visited Namdaemun Market after attending the 54th Parents' Day ceremony at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul, that morning. <<> As the presidential couple appeared, citizens expressed their delight, saying, "We're really lucky today," and "Cheer up." The President exchanged handshakes and high-fives with citizens, asking, "Have you eaten?" and complimented young people holding carnations, saying, "The flowers are very pretty." He also took selfies with foreign tourists visiting Korea. The couple purchased hats, eyeglass straps, and dumplings using Onnuri gift certificates and cash. As the First Lady chose a hat, the President joined in shopping, remarking, "That’s nice. Black is the best." <<> The President inquired about business conditions from the merchants to gauge the on-site situation. Some merchants shared opinions such as, "Although the overall economy is tough, the increase in foreign tourists is bringing back some vitality compared to before," and "We need support to attract more foreign tourists." <<> Following this, the presidential couple had lunch at a pork hock restaurant in Namdaemun Market. The President recalled, "I remember visiting Namdaemun Market when I was preparing for the bar exam and enjoying delicious pork hocks." He also asked the head of the merchants' association, Moon Nam-yeop, who joined the meal, about the market's atmosphere and facility maintenance status. <<> Spokesperson Ahn explained, "This visit was arranged to encourage small business owners facing difficulties due to the economic downturn from the Middle East situation, to hear their voices directly, and to review measures for revitalizing tourism and traditional markets in line with the recent increase in foreign tourists visiting Korea." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 8일 서울 남대문시장을 방문해 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁에 따른 경기 위축으로 어려움을 겪은 상인들을 격려했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "I'm not sure if the martial law hurt the public... Salvation through 'Judas's Betrayal'" (장동혁 “계엄이 국민에 상처줬는지 모르겠다…‘유다의 배신’ 통해 구원”)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, "I'm not sure if the martial law caused wounds to the public or brought about confusion," adding, "Over time, that incident (the martial law) could be another event through which South Korea overcomes those wounds and moves forward in a different form." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 “(비상)계엄이 국민에게 상처를 주고 어떤 혼란을 가져왔을지 모르겠다”며 “시간이 지나면 그것(계엄)을 통해서 대한민국은 그 상처를 딛고 또 다른 모습으로 나아갈 수 있는 또 하나의 사건”이라고 말했다.)

Jang made these remarks on the afternoon of the 8th at a press conference with foreign correspondents hosted by the Seoul Foreign Correspondents' Club at the Press Center in Jung-gu, Seoul, in response to a foreign correspondent's question: "While you oppose the martial law, do you think the impeachment (of former President Yoon Suk-yeol) should not have happened?" Furthermore, Jang stated, "Impeachment is not the only way to resolve the martial law. After the martial law, there were discussions within the party about a gradual resignation (of former President Yoon). Due to our internal divisions, that did not come to fruition, and ultimately, our People Power Party itself opened the door to impeachment." (장 대표는 8일 오후 서울 중구 프레스센터에서 열린 서울외신기자클럽 초청 외신기자 간담회에 참석해 “계엄에는 반대하지만 (윤석열 전 대통령) 탄핵은 이뤄져선 안 됐다고 생각하는 것인지”라는 외신기자의 질문에 이같이 답했다. 아울러 장 대표는 “계엄을 해결하는 유일한 방법이 탄핵은 아니다”며 “계엄 이후 당내에서도 (윤 전 대통령의) 점진적 퇴진에 대한 논의가 있었다. 우리 내부의 분열로 인해 그것은 관철되지 못하고 결국 우리 국민의힘 스스로 탄핵의 문을 열어줬다”고 말했다.)

The reporter brought up Jang's past actions, including his remark after voting to lift the martial law in the National Assembly that "the martial law is part of God's plan," and posed this question. In response, Jang also said, "God accomplished the history of salvation He intended through the event of Judas betraying Jesus. That is my faith as a Christian." (해당 기자는 비상 계엄 해제 국회 표결에 참여한 뒤에 “계엄은 하나님의 계획”이라고 발언했던 장 대표의 과거 행보를 거론하며 이러한 질문을 던졌다. 이에 대해서도 장 대표는 “하나님은 유다가 예수님을 배신하는 사건을 통해서도 하나님께서 이루고자 하는 구원의 역사를 이루셨다. 그게 크리스천으로서의 제 믿음이다”고 말하기도 했다.)

Regarding the PPP's nominations for the by-elections for National Assembly seats, which will be held alongside the June 3 local elections, where many 'pro-Yoon Suk-yeol' figures, including former lawmaker Lee Yong (Gyeonggi Hanam-gap), who served as the head of Yoon's campaign office during his presidential bid, have been nominated—sparking a 'Yoon Again' controversy—questions were also raised. When another foreign correspondent asked, "In the June 3 local elections, candidates close to former President Yoon are being nominated. What do you think about that?" Jang responded, "If you say that using very subjective and vague expressions like 'close to former President Yoon' should disqualify someone from being nominated, the PPP might hardly find anyone to nominate in this local election. Instead, I ask: Is Jeon Jae-soo, the Busan mayoral candidate, okay? And is Kim Kyung-soo, the Gyeongnam governor candidate, who destroyed the election—the flower of democracy—through comment manipulation, okay?" (국민의힘은 6·3지방선거와 함께 치러지는 국회의원 재보궐 선거에 윤 전 대통령 대선 후보 시절 수행실장을 맡은 이용 전 의원(경기 하남갑) 등 ‘친윤석열계’ 인사들을 다수 공천하며 ‘윤어게인’ 논란이 일었는데, 이에 대한 질문도 있었다. “(6·3 지방선거에서) 윤석열 전 대통령과 가까운 후보들에게 공천이 진행되고 있는데 어떻게 생각하느냐”는 다른 외신기자의 질문에 장 대표는 “윤 전 대통령과 가깝다고 하는 매우 주관적이고 모호한 표현으로 공천하지 말아야 한다고 한다면 국민의힘은 이번 지방선거에서 공천할 사람을 거의 찾을 수 없을지도 모르겠다”며 “오히려 묻겠다. 전재수 부산시장 후보는 괜찮나? 그리고 댓글조작을 통해 민주주의의 꽃인 선거를 무너뜨린 김경수 경남지사 후보는 괜찮나”고 되물었다.)

When asked about how he evaluates the foreign policy of the Lee Jae-myung administration, Jang said, "Looking at the Coupang incident, although it started as a personal information leakage issue, there are growing concerns in the United States about whether it is being handled fairly and equitably compared to how previous personal information leaks at other companies were handled. I think it raises questions about whether a series of these issues are occurring independently of relations with China or North Korea." (장 대표는 이재명 정부의 외교정책을 어떻게 평가하는지에 대한 질문에는 “쿠팡 사태를 본다면, 그것이 개인정보 유출 문제로 시작됐지만 다른 기업들에서 이전에 발생한 개인정보 유출을 다루던 방식과 평등하고 균형 있게 다루고 있는가에 대해 미국에서 여러 우려를 표하고 있다”며 “일련의 문제들이 중국이나 북한과의 관계와 무관하게 일어나고 있는 건지 의문을 갖게 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the constitutional amendment bill that failed to pass the National Assembly plenary session due to opposition from the PPP, Jang said, "The Lee Jae-myung regime and the Democratic Party are talking about constitutional amendments while continuing anti-constitutional actions. I think these actions are tantamount to breaking down the house that is the constitution while saying, 'Let's replace the window glass.'" (이날 국민의힘 반대로 국회 본회의 문턱을 넘지 못한 헌법 개정안 대해 장 대표는 “이재명 정권과 민주당이 반헌법적인 행동을 계속하면서 개헌을 하겠다고 한다”며 “이러한 행동들은 헌법이라는 집을 무너뜨리면서 한편에서는 유리창을 갈자고 하는 것과 마찬가지라고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)
